description: This Java source file is a test class for the 'LoanProductChargeOffReasonMappings' component of the Apache Fineract project. It contains JUnit test methods that verify creating, updating, and validation scenarios for loan products with charge-off reasons and associated expense accounts. The class extends a base integration test class and interacts with multiple helper classes and external models to perform setup and assertions.

classes.name: LoanProductChargeOffReasonMappingsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the creation, update, and validation of loan products with charge-off reasons and expense accounts in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: testCreateAndUpdateLoanProductWithValidChargeOffReason
methods.description: Tests creating a loan product with a valid charge-off reason, then updates it to a different expense account, verifying the changes.

methods.name: testCreateLoanProductWithInvalidGLAccount
methods.description: Verifies that creating a loan product with an invalid general ledger account ID results in a validation error.

methods.name: testCreateLoanProductWithInvalidChargeOffReason
methods.description: Verifies that creating a loan product with an invalid charge-off reason ID results in a validation error.

methods.name: loanProductsRequest
methods.description: Helper method to construct a detailed PostLoanProductsRequest object with specified charge-off reason and GL account IDs.

methods.name: createChargeOffReason
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a charge-off reason code from the system and returns its ID.

methods.name: createPostChargeOffReasonToExpenseAccountMappings
methods.description: Creates a list containing a mapping of charge-off reason code to an expense account ID.
